source: User report after the verified I64 rollback
prior_user_report: I tested it is about 10-20 perfcent slower
interpretation: Recovery after restoring the only functional source change strongly supports the I64-to-I32 instruction-cache reduction as the cause of the reported slowdown.
decision: Retain the I64 seed16 core as the performance baseline; do not promote the standalone I32 reduction.
future_validation: Cache capacity reductions require a representative Pocket performance comparison; scalar cache estimates and fixed CPU publication GPU replay do not establish performance parity.
